characters.description: Gutten som vokste opp på residensen etter farens løfte. Han har lært fransk, tysk og protokoll, men ikke å svømme, og havner i Hvittenland i en båt som går av seg selv.
characters.look: A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about nineteen with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw. characters.name: Den unge kongen (fiskerens sønn)
characters.description: Oppdratt ved den kongelige residensen etter et uhyggelig løfte, dras han inn i Hvittenlands prøvelser, vinner en dronning—og mister henne igjen når han bruker en ønskering uten å tenke.
characters.look: A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about twenty-one with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw, dressed like a king: a long dark-navy cloak trimmed with thick brown fur at the neck, over a cream roll-neck jumper, dark trousers and tan boots, with a thin, shiny gold ring on one finger.

characters.name: Fiskeren
characters.description: Guttens far, som har levert fisk til kongens kjøkken i tjue år, og som lover bort det han ikke vet at konen bærer på.
characters.look: A lean, wiry fisherman of about forty-five with a long, weather-beaten face, deep laughter lines, a sharp nose, kind, crinkly blue eyes and a long, drooping black moustache but no beard. He wears a round, brimless old sealskin cap, a thick grey wool jumper, orange oilskin bib trousers and white rubber boots.

characters.name: Den yngste prinsessen
characters.description: Den tredje av kongsdøtrene som står nedgravd på stranden i Hvittenland. Hun roper ikke på hjelp, men forklarer gutten hvordan søstrene kan bli fri.
characters.look: A calm, thoughtful young woman of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a plain, long-sleeved sky-blue wool dress with a narrow belt of silver links and a thin silver circlet with one pearl.

characters.name: Dronningen av Hvittenland (den yngste prinsessen)
characters.description: Den klokeste av tre bundne søstre som kjenner trollenes regler, gir ham veien gjennom prøvelsene og setter én betingelse: at han lytter til faren, ikke moren.
characters.look: A calm young queen of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a slim silver tiara set with pale-blue stones, a long, simple sky-blue gown and a short white faux-fur jacket fastened with a round silver clasp.

characters.name: Den gamle kongen ved residensen
characters.description: Mannen som reddet gutten som barn og ga ham utdanning og trygghet, men som senere utfordrer ham av stolthet—og utløser tapet ved å kreve å se dronningen.
characters.look: A skinny, elderly man with a bald, shiny head, a clean-shaven face, a long pointed chin, sharp grey eyes and a thin-lipped mouth with deep lines around it. He wears a peacock-blue three-piece suit with a silk pocket square, a white shirt with a stiff collar, a navy tie and polished black shoes, and carries himself very straight.

characters.name: Veiviseren på den hvite stranden
characters.description: En gammel mann i lys, slitt frakk som møter ham i Hvittenland og gir den avgjørende testen: gå forbi de to første prinsessene og hjelp den tredje.
characters.look: A lean, straight-backed old man of about eighty, as bony and long-limbed as a heron, with a long, narrow, sun-browned face, a hooked nose, bright pale-blue eyes under wild white eyebrows and a long white beard braided into one thin plait with a tiny white shell tied at its end. He wears a battered, pale-yellow oilskin coat that flaps in the wind, a pale sou’wester and tall black rubber boots, and leans on a twisted, silver-grey driftwood staff.

characters.name: Trollet med ni hoder
characters.description: Det siste og verste av de tre trollene i slottet. Det kommer den tredje natten med ni hoder og ni ris.
characters.look: A troll as tall as a house, with a huge, round, lumpy body of creamy-white hide covered in big chocolate-brown patches like a cow's, stumpy legs and big round hands with thick claws. Nine heads grow in a ring around the top of its body like a crown, each with a wide pink snout, small sleepy brown eyes, floppy ears and a wide, grinning mouth. It wears a huge, faded red-and-white checked flannel shirt like a nightshirt.

characters.name: Nordavinden
characters.description: En viljesterk, talende stormkraft som griper inn når alt står på spill, og gir den unge kongen en brutal, presis plan for å stanse bryllupet.
characters.look: A tall, lean, long-limbed storm giant, three times as tall as a man, with a long, bony, windburnt face, hollow cheeks, a long thin nose, a wide mouth pursed to blow and bright, shining silver eyes. His wild, tangled slate-grey hair and long, wispy beard stream sideways as if in a gale. He wears a huge, billowing cloak made of dark-grey storm clouds, torn into ragged wisps at the edges, and from the knees down he fades into swirling grey mist.

places.name: the Castle in Whiteland
places.look: A long, low, white modern building in a clearing of dark spruce just above a beach of dazzling white sand, with flat roofs edged by glowing blue light strips, big dark windows and a wide flight of pale stone steps up to glass double doors. In front of it, a white wall with an arched gateway. It looks like a brand-new conference hotel that nobody ever got round to opening.
